newsitem.title: CHINA: Kerr-McGee signs China oil contract.
newsitem.headline: Kerr-McGee signs China oil contract.

text.p: U.S. oil firm Kerr-McGee Corp on Wednesday signed a contract with the China National Offshore Oil Corporation (CNOOC) to explore for oil in the South China Sea, the Xinhua news agency said.
Under the contract, Kerr-McGee would undertake all exploration risk and would be responsible for drilling and prospecting in the 4,500-square km 26/06 block, the official agency said.

Kerr-McGee had been cooperating with CNOOC since 1994, and already had exploration contracts for two areas in the China's northern Bohai Bay and three in the Pearl River Delta areas in the South China Sea, it said.
The U.S. company also owned a 24.5 percent stake in the Liuhua 11-1 Oilfield, China's largest offshore oilfield, it said but gave no further details of the new deal.
